title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Data Comparison and Chart Description – Opinion Essay on Data Presentation
prompt: In many workplaces and academic settings, people are increasingly required to interpret and present data from charts, graphs, and tables. Some believe that the ability to describe data accurately in writing is now an essential skill for everyone, while others argue that it is only necessary for specialists such as scientists and analysts. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请针对题目中的两种观点进行讨论，并明确给出你自己的立场。建议先分别阐述双方理由，再结合实例（可虚构）说明你的看法。注意段落清晰、论证充分，字数不少于250词。
